title: kb_mcp tests fail when the clone is behind its upstream
goal: test_kb_mcp.py's pack assertions pass in a clone or worktree that is behind its upstream: the tests run kb_pack with the kb-copy freshness line switched off or strip it before asserting coverage, and a test named test_kb_mcp_pack_ignores_freshness_banner plants a behind state and proves it
notes: Broke four subagent test runs and one push gate during SP-4udo5jmw while another machine pushed to origin.
